name: web-earthy-home-decor-bento-landing
title: Earthy Home Decor Bento Hero
whatItIs: A warm greige landing hero with a large brown 'flowE.co' wordmark headline, tagline, phone CTA, lotus line icon and paragraph on the left, and a bento grid on the right mixing interior photographs with solid beige and dark brown text tiles.
whatItMeans: Chocolate brown on greige with natural wood photography feels calm, crafted and expensive. The bento mix of photo and color tiles adds rhythm without noise.
techniques: Bento grid alternating photos and flat color tiles
Brown-only text palette instead of black for warmth
Big soft rounded sans wordmark as the headline
Single-line lotus icon as a gentle brand accent
Ample margin and left-aligned copy for a quiet reading flow

vocabulary.definition: A modular layout of uneven rectangular tiles.
A palette built from close shades of one hue family.
A simple icon drawn with a thin uniform stroke.
